Overview

Bluefields is a city in RA with a population of 60,000. Nicaragua’s main Caribbean port, a multicultural city with Creole, Miskito, and Garifuna heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
